comparison.objective: Thread an ISO 17712 bolt seal through a container-door cam-keeper hasp and close its barrel.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid pin-through-hasp alignment and irreversible barrel latching.
comparison.success_condition: Bolt threaded through the hasp and barrel closed; body gives no insertion-depth, latch-force, or door-state thresholds.
comparison.reason: Seal threading and latching are assembly operations, whereas the candidate removes sacrificial tangs through controlled fracture and must recover every fragment without disturbing retained inserts.
